title: File:Odle, Puez, Sella and Langkofel groups from Seceda, South Tyrol.jpg
desc: Panoramic view from Seceda (2,519 m) in the Dolomites of South Tyrol across Val Gardena. From left to right, the image shows the Odle (Geisler) Group with the characteristic rock formations around Fermeda, the Puez Group, the Sella Group and, at the right edge, parts of the Langkofel Group. Alpine meadows, paths and tourist infrastructure on Seceda are visible in the foreground.
